_doc: API list prices in USD per million tokens, used to show what Claude Code sessions WOULD cost at API prices (a subscription covers them). match = substring of the model id, first row wins, so put specific ids first. cacheRead defaults to 0.1 x in; cacheWrite5m / cacheWrite1h default to 1.25 x / 2 x in. Override or extend with costs.modelPrices (a file of the same shape) in config/server-os.yaml. Prices as of 2026-10-06.
